templates.why_chosen: Star, high-confidence pipeline flanked by labelled Input and Output panels, with a dotted Perspect boundary separating the paper's own compute-filter-refine loop from off-the-shelf tools attached above and below the main line.
templates.what_to_learn: Bookend a pipeline with explicit Input/Output panels rather than bare arrows at the edges, attach third-party tool names as small boxes above or below the stage they instrument instead of putting them on the main line, and mark the contribution with a dotted boundary plus one internal feedback arrow.

templates.why_chosen: A left-to-right analysis pipeline feeds a dotted-boundary Relational-debugger box whose own Compute-Filter-Refine loop is the only part with a feedback arrow, keeping external tools (Dyninst, RR, PIN) visually outside the system boundary.
templates.what_to_learn: Draw a dotted boundary around your own system's box to separate it from the off-the-shelf tools and inputs/outputs surrounding it, and confine the return arrow to the one internal stage that actually repeats (Refine back to Compute) rather than looping the whole pipeline.
